protocol: envs/walker_ragdoll_env.py at ENV_VERSION standup_balance_walk_curriculum_v9, task_phase=target, reset_mode=mixed, 50 seeded episodes (seed 11), 1000 steps per episode, standing band = torso z in (1.0, 2.0) as the env defines it, upright threshold 0.8 as the env's is_healthy uses it
why: a low falls_per_episode is not evidence of standing: termination only latches after an episode has been healthy, so a policy that never reaches the band never registers a fall
